# Phantom Chat

Phantom Chat is a lightning-fast anonymous ephemeral chat with no login, no phone number, and no email required. Create self-destructing private rooms instantly.

Website: https://phantomchat.space

Key features:
- Instant anonymous chat rooms with zero registration
- No login, no account, no signup required
- No phone number, no email, no tracking cookies
- Self-destructing rooms that expire automatically after countdown
- Progressive Web App (PWA) support
- Identity-less communication with deterministic device DNA
- Zero persistent storage of messages or chat history
